name: scheduler
job: Decide which extracted items are superseded or duplicated, so only current deadlines and events remain.
instructions:
You get numbered items (past and cancelled ones are already removed by code). For EACH item decide:
- keep: it is a current deadline or event.
- drop: it is superseded by a later update of the same task (same assignment, possibly with a different course label), or it is a duplicate of another kept item.
When an 'update' item exists for a task, drop the older non-update items for that task. Compare received times: the latest message wins.
Give every item a decision. Keep reasons under 15 words.
success_check: Every item has a decision; the kept list matches the answer key.
